pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.g3 e6 4.Bg2 c6 5.Nh3
pages.notes: The overview linked 5.Nh3 to a ...Bb4 pin and plan 4 routed the bishop d7-e8-h5 through the d7-pawn. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 4 (reviewer: plan 4's 'traded on a6' rejected, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.g3 e6 4.Bg2 d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Qe8 with the king on e8 and ...g5-g4 from g7; plan 3 routed the bishop through the d7-pawn and pushed ...c6-c5 with the pawn on c7; plan 2 called e3 a break. Rewrote plans 1-3 (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.g3 e6 4.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8; plan 3 called ...Bb4 a pin (d2-pawn in the way); plan 4 called e5 a light square. Rewrote all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.g3 e6 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8 and ...g5-g4 from g7. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.g3 e6 5.Nf3 d5 6.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 into Black's d5-pawn and called e3 a break; plan 2 read e4 as a move. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.g3 e6 5.Nf3 d5 6.O-O Bd6 7.b3
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Qe8-h5 with the king on e8; plan 3 pushed d5 into Black's pawn; plan 4 routed the bishop through the d7-pawn. Rewrote plans 2-4 (reviewer: plan 4 rejected once, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Dutch-Indian, 5.Bd2
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 gave White the bishop pair after ...Bxd2+; plan 2 played ...Qe8 with the king on e8; plan 4 put White's e4 push in Black's plan. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: Dutch-Indian, 5.Nd2
